issue.title: Mac CaptureRelationEqualsAliasTests fast-double-equals test records one capture-rewrite ask instead of two on some CI runs
issue.description: testFastDoubleEqualsBeforeReplyCollapsesToOne asserts two capture-rewrite asks for the first draft, but the first ask is recorded only if its Task launches fake-bob before the second key's probe cancels it; on a loaded runner it sometimes does not.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Observed by the bob-cli-j6 lander in bob-mac-capture macOS CI (GitHub macOS 26 runner), failing assertion `CaptureRelationEqualsAliasTests.swift:764` `XCTAssertEqual(asks.count, 2)` with `("1") is not equal to ("2")`:

- FAIL: snapshot run 42685512004 (ci/precommit, 2026-11-09T19:39Z), tree identical to master b1a90fa (`git diff` empty), 0.855 s.
- PASS: master run 42684781881 on b1a90fa, the same tree, 4 minutes earlier. Also PASS on 3131414, 2d1c3164, 0eeba70, and 5987de4 (run 42686284282, fully green).
- FAIL: snapshot run 42670088587 (ci/precommit, 2026-11-09T18:00Z, the bob-cli-j6.2 working tree), same assertion, 1.109 s.
- Of the 36 recent runs whose log shows this test, it passed 34 times, including all 29 runs before bob-cli-j6.2's ef5dc4a. The two failures are 2 of the 7 runs carrying that code (small sample; roughly 3% by chance if the rate were constant). j6.2's diff does not change the `=`/`=` path, so no j6 regression was found.

Not reproduced serially (no Mac XCTest off CI).

Likely root cause, from code reading only: the test types `=` then `=` synchronously on the main actor. Key 1's `editorTextDidChange` calls `startCaptureRewrite`, which spawns a Task that runs fake-bob (recording its argv). Key 2's `.typeKeyBeforeEqualsReply` starts `startEqualsProbeRewrite`, which runs `rewriteTask?.cancel()` first. If the runner has not launched the first Task's process before that cancel, the first ask is never recorded, and only the probe's ask remains, giving 1 not 2. Fix by making the assertion robust to that race (for example require at least the probe's ask, and wait on the observable collapse), not by loosening the collapse assertions.

Same family, different tests, no confirmed shared root cause: `CaptureSeparatorToggleTests.testOlderBobMoveAliasReplyLeavesLiteralWithoutOpeningPicker` (line 1220) failed once on 0eeba70 run 42686147592 and passed on b1a90fa and 5987de4, whose Swift sources differ only by a comment; `CaptureSeparatorToggleTests.testUnchangedAliasReplyLeavesPeriodLiteralWithoutOpeningPicker` (line 1118) failed once in snapshot run 42666675195 and passed in later runs.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: swift test --filter CaptureRelationEqualsAliasTests (macOS CI full suite, bob-mac-capture)

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-j6 landing gate went red on this test on a tree identical to one that passed on master, so it is a flake rather than an alias regression; the lander files it so it is not lost when the epic closes.
